title: Streaming vs Calculated Insights for Sub-Minute Triggers

steps.prompt: Commerce wants an engagement the moment a shopper views 3 products inside a 5-minute sliding window. Leadership will not accept next-day batch scores for this use case. Which Data 360 capability fits?

options.label: Streaming Insights with time-based sliding window aggregations over the browse event stream
options.rationale: Streaming Insights evaluate aggregations as events arrive, enabling near-real-time windowed triggers that batch Calculated Insights cannot meet.

options.label: Batch Calculated Insights scheduled once every 24 hours on historical browse history
options.rationale: Calculated Insights excel at scheduled historical metrics; a once-daily batch misses the live 5-minute browse window entirely.

options.label: Scheduled Apex Batch counting Product_View__c rows with SOQL
options.rationale: Apex/SOQL on CRM objects cannot economically process web-scale streaming telemetry or Data 360 streaming engines.
